EXTERNAL_RIBASIM_COUPLED.swap_exchange_role: compute soil/drainage physical response and publish candidate signed exchange
EXTERNAL_RIBASIM_COUPLED.coupler_role: resolve transaction ordering, feasibility and exactly-once cross-model transfer
EXTERNAL_RIBASIM_COUPLED.ribasim_role: own accepted surface-water storage/level/network and hydraulic realization

hard_invariants: For one physical surface-water store, SWAP_FIXED_WEIR and EXTERNAL_RIBASIM ownership are mutually exclusive.
No physical surface-water storage volume may appear in both SWAP committed state and Ribasim accepted state.
The same drainage transfer may not be both internal to SWAP combined storage and external to Ribasim in one application profile.
Exactly one realized signed exchange crosses the SWAP-Ribasim boundary and is booked once per model with opposite signs.
A rejected SWAP trial or rejected coupled window may not change accepted Ribasim surface-water state or accepted management memory.
Ribasim-owned availability/supply state may not be duplicated as a private SWAP availability limiter in external-owner mode.
SWAP may retain constitutive drainage/infiltration response while the cross-model feasibility limiter is resolved at the coupling boundary.
Automatic management target memory is policy state, not physical surface-water storage.
required_fail_closed_cases: same drainage scalar classified as both SWAP internal and SWAP external mass
negative/infiltration request accepted without external availability resolution
management policy driven by uncommitted SWAP trial state
current_gap: No current production application-profile contract is yet shown to enforce these mode exclusions. Q1A tests external state ownership physically; Q3 must test signed exchange and mass reclassification.
relation_to_rm13: The current RM13 minimal real three-model research profile has drainage disabled, so it does not qualify the surface-water owner-mode mass reclassification.
